name: Change of Pace
description: Relax and Refuel with Casual Poolside Dining. Sunshine, good company and coastal cuisine - that's the Change of Pace experience. This laid-back eatery just steps from the outdoor pools beckons you with the irresistible aroma of sizzling burgers and refreshing tropical cocktails. Indulge in a leisurely breakfast overlooking the pool or refuel your adventure with casual lunch and dinner options.
